title: Item Search — Product Groups: dragging a column edge stores the whole drag distance but the column renders only about 6% of it, because the result table is pinned to its container width
requirementSource: NM-1852 (Grid Options: column width persists locally and Reset to Default View clears it) — the feature exists, so a drag is meant to resize the column visibly, as it does on the Item Search -> Products grid, where the same handle moves the column edge with the pointer.
stepsToReproduce: Open Item Search -> Product Groups on the e2e environment (office 1101), search 'ZZ E2E' (22 groups).
Grid Options -> Reset to Default View, then read the Name header width (317 px on a 962 px wide table on 2026-09-09).
Press on the Name column's right-edge resize handle (accessible name 'Resize column productGroupName'), drag 150 px to the right and release.
Read local storage key product-groups-table-settings -> columnSizing.productGroupName is 550 (400 + 150): the drag was stored in full.

Read the Name header width -> about 328 px: it grew about 11 px for a 150 px drag. Drags of +50 / +300 / -300 store 450 / 900 / 600 and render 320 / 336 / 328 px; the other three handles behave the same.
Compare on Item Search -> Products: the same 200 px drag on a column edge grows the table from 1315 to 1515 px and the column follows the pointer.
expectedBehavior: The column edge follows the pointer: a 150 px drag widens the column by about 150 px (the table growing or the neighbours shrinking), matching what the Products grid does with the same control.
actualBehavior: The table keeps width: 100% of its container while the requested column widths already exceed that container, so the browser renormalises every column and the drag shows as a few pixels. The stored preference and the rendered grid disagree; a user cannot make a column meaningfully wider.

mcpEvidence.findings: Reproduced live on the e2e environment, office 1101, with a real pointer sequence (press, move in steps, release) through headless Playwright and the suite's saved sign-in. Machine outputs in .playwright-cli/pgr-2026-09-09/: probes-resize-response.json (Name: +50/+150/+300/-300 -> stored 450/600/900/600, rendered 320/328/336/328 px, table width 962 px throughout, table style width 100%), probes-resize-all-handles.json (+60 px on each of the four handles -> stored 460/510/410/210, rendered +2 to +4 px each), probes-products-resize-compare.json (Products grid: table 1315 -> 1515 px for +200), screenshots 20-resize-response.png, 22-products-resize-compare.png, 24-resize-all-handles.png.

networkEvidence: n/a — a client-side layout defect; no request is involved. The stored preference is written to local storage on release and restored after a reload.
notes: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-10 by owner ruling: accepted behaviour, not a defect. TC-ISR-PGR-038 is unchanged: it already asserts the stored delta plus wider-than-before and never a one-to-one rendered change, so it pins the accepted behaviour as is. History preserved: Severity assessed low: a usability defect with no data impact. TC-ISR-PGR-038 asserts the stored delta plus 'wider than before' and deliberately not a one-to-one rendered change; tighten it to the rendered width once the fix lands.
